crossRefs.note: He called one of the servants to him, and asked what was going on.
When he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred up, saying, “Who is this?”
The multitudes said, “This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.”

translations.web: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.
translations.bsb: When he heard the crowd going by, he asked what was happening.
translations.kjv: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.
translations.asv: and hearing a multitude going by, he inquired what this meant.
